General Information

What is this Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Left Side (driver) Rear Brake Cylinder for 1985 thru 1995 Suzuki Samurai’s
These are the Hydraulic Cylinders that activate the lever assembly to engage the rear brake shoes
Suzuki OEM Part
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Rear Brake Cylinder (Driver Side)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
